title: CI baseline: fix the three failing JS suites and add the tests workflow
description:
## Goal
Make the existing automated tests a reliable CI gate before the packaging and CMS work lands: fix the three JS suites that fail on `develop` today and add one `tests.yml` workflow that runs the green suites on every PR. Later tickets add their own tests to this workflow.

## Context
- Spike PPY-82be6c finding 8: `test:newsroom` (forum routes), `test:theme-packs` and `test:newsroom-card-layout` already fail on develop (not caused by the spike); `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean.
- Scripts live in `package.json`: `test:newsroom` = `node scripts/test-newsroom-session.cjs && node scripts/test-newsroom-forum-routes.cjs && node scripts/test-theme-packs.cjs`; `test:theme-packs` = `scripts/test-theme-packs.cjs`; `test:newsroom-card-layout` = `scripts/test-newsroom-card-layout.cjs`; others: `test:anth-us-brand`, `test:markus-projection`, `test:markus-to-article`, `test:renderer-config`, `typecheck`. The `.cjs` tests load `lib/*.ts` through a hand-rolled require hook; `scripts/register-papyrus-aliases.cjs` maps `papyrus-site` / `papyrus-amplify-outputs`.
- Python: `pyproject.toml` `testpaths = ["procedures/newsroom/tests", "publications/threat_intelligence/tests"]`; backend Gherkin `poetry run behave features_backend --tags=~@live-agent` (`npm run test:bdd:backend`). Only `.github/workflows/inbound-email-tests.yml` exists (path-filtered, installs `--extras newsroom`).
- AGENTS.md: no compatibility fallbacks; if a test asserts an old shape, change the test to the current behavior, do not re-add the old behavior.

## Exact changes
1. Reproduce each failure (`npm ci && npm run test:newsroom; npm run test:theme-packs; npm run test:newsroom-card-layout`), record the first failing assertion for each in this ticket, and decide per failure: (a) the test is stale -> update the assertion to the current code; (b) the code regressed -> fix the code (small) or, if the fix is large, open a separate Kanbus bug under PPY-655994, exclude that single script in `tests.yml` with a comment naming the bug id. Do not delete tests.
2. `.github/workflows/tests.yml` (new), triggers `pull_request` and `push` to `develop`, `permissions: contents: read`:
   - job `ts` (node 22): `npm ci`; `npm run typecheck`; `npm run test:newsroom`; `npm run test:theme-packs`; `npm run test:anth-us-brand`; `npm run test:newsroom-card-layout`; `npm run test:markus-projection`; `npm run test:markus-to-article`; `npm run test:renderer-config`; `node amplify/functions/reader-settings/handler.test.mjs`; `node amplify/functions/shared/email-submission.test.mjs`.
   - job `python` (python 3.12, `pip install poetry`): `poetry install --no-interaction --extras "newsroom markus"`; `poetry run python -m unittest discover -s procedures/newsroom/tests -t . -p "test_*.py" -v` EXCLUDING live/network modules (`test_content_cli_live.py`, anything requiring `PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_JWT`/AWS; list exclusions explicitly with a reason in a YAML comment); `poetry run behave features_backend --tags=~@live-agent`; `poetry run behave features/operator-cli.feature`.
   - Each suite that cannot run in CI gets an explicit, commented exclusion; no silent skips.
3. `package.json`: add `"test:ci:ts"` aggregating the `ts` job commands so humans run the same thing locally.

## Data shapes
None.

## Tests
This ticket is about tests; its deliverable is a green `tests.yml`. If a stale assertion is rewritten, the rewritten assertion is the test.

## Acceptance checks
- `npm run test:ci:ts` exits 0 locally after `npm ci`.
- `poetry run python -m unittest discover -s procedures/newsroom/tests -t . -p "test_*.py"` (with the documented exclusions) exits 0.
- The PR's `tests` workflow is green on GitHub.
- `git diff --stat` shows no production-code change except the minimal fixes for category (b), each explained in the PR description.

## Dependencies
None. Parallel with `PPY-78e818` (different workflow files). Conflicts: touches `package.json` scripts (also touched by `PPY-78e818`, `PPY-cddfb8`, `PPY-8ef4ca`: rebase, trivial).

## Risks
- The Python suite may contain tests needing network or AWS; the exclusion list must be explicit. If more than ~5 modules fail for unrelated reasons, file one bug per cluster instead of fixing here.
- Running `behave` needs `--extras newsroom` (limatus is base now; tactus is in the extra).

## Needs Ryan
Nothing.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 2 ticket)
- Work from a clean worktree of `origin/develop` (`git -C /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus fetch origin && git worktree add ../Papyrus-worktrees/<this-ticket> -b feature/PPY-302a5f-<slug> origin/develop`). Never commit to `develop` or `main`; open a PR into `develop`; never merge to `main`. Conventional-commit messages. Update this ticket with branch, PR link and the verification output.
- `AGENTS.md` rules that bind this work: no backward-compatibility shims or fallbacks (clean breaks); backend tooling in Python unless noted; Pretext owns text measurement (do not measure DOM in React); read `AGENTS.local.md` before ANY AWS/Amplify/sandbox command; never run `ampx pipeline-deploy` locally (sandbox only).
- Note on language direction: Ryan's 2026-10-05 correction (epic comment 4174c5) says Papyrus is being ported from Python to TypeScript. Phase 2 follows the approved design in docs/standard-site.md (Python CLI/Lambdas + `papyrus-newsroom`). Keep new Python logic in small pure functions with fixture-driven tests so it can be ported; do not add new Python dependencies beyond those named here.
- Tests: Python unit tests are `unittest` under `procedures/newsroom/tests/` (run: `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.<module> -v`); backend Gherkin is `behave` under `features_backend/` with steps in `features_backend/steps/` (run: `poetry run behave features_backend/<file>.feature`); UI Gherkin is cucumber-js + Playwright under `features/` (run against a dev server: `npm run dev` then `PAPYRUS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 npx cucumber-js features/<file>.feature`); TypeScript unit tests are `scripts/test-*.ts` run with `npx tsx` (add an npm script `test:<name>` in package.json).
- Install: `poetry install --extras "newsroom markus"` and `npm ci`. Verify `markus --version` prints 0.5.1 (PyPI `anthus-markus` 0.5.1 emits IR `schema_version: 1`).
right_now_summary: The team is fixing three failing JavaScript suites and adding a CI workflow to run tests on every pull request.
